valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2028 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD NYSE listing, no ADR conversion. Anchor: FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance $13.70-$13.80 (raised Nov 3; Q3 adjusted EPS $3.68, Q4 guide $4.05-$4.15, organic growth 13-15%, segment margin 24.1-24.5%). FY2027 and FY2028 EPS are my assumptions (about +17% and +15%), not sourced consensus; figures come from press-release reprints, not the 8-K itself.

bear.driver: Data-center and electrical capex cycle slows, organic growth fades to high single digits, margins flat and the multiple de-rates toward the pre-AI industrial range.

base.driver: Record orders and backlog convert, organic growth stays double digit through 2027 then high single digit, segment margin edges toward 26%.

bull.driver: Data-center and grid demand sustains mid-teens growth with further margin expansion and buybacks.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS the $352.97 close implies 18.8x FY2028 EPS (about 25.7x the FY2026 guidance midpoint of $13.75). The simple mean of the named post-earnings targets (about $476, no documented 12-month horizon) implies 25.3x base EPS, or $19.8 of EPS at 24x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $18.80 (about 5.3% of the close); $1 of FY2028 EPS moves it by $24.
valuation.watch_metric: Orders, backlog and organic growth in Electrical Americas and Global (data-center demand), with segment margin against the 25.4-25.8% Q4 guide.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results, expected early February 2027; the exact date is not sourced here.

analyst_notes: After the Nov 3 results most named targets moved little: RBC raised to $539, Wells Fargo cut to $485 from $503, while Jefferies sits at $395 Neutral. Named targets span $395 to $539, median near $485, well above the $451 base; the gap is about 1.5 turns of P/E or roughly $1.50 of FY2028 EPS at 24x. No call documents a 12-month horizon so none enters a weighted target; the list is a subset from an aggregator.
